_description: Which identifier fields each kind of SBOM component must carry for a matcher (Grype) and the grid to use it (req-cicd-sbom-32). The starting rows come from the attested tap-web CycloneDX document, where every apk, pypi, npm and generic component carries a purl and cpe, apk components also carry arch, distro and syft:metadata:originPackage, and the github-type uv/uvx entries carry a purl only.

apk._description: Alpine/Wolfi packages. Grype matches apk packages on the purl with its distro and arch qualifiers and on the CPE; the upstream qualifier names the source package and is required only when the origin package differs from the component name (54 of 54 on the real document).

pypi._description: Python packages from the locked closure. License and architecture are read from the wheels in the image's cache seed (req-cicd-sbom-33); a component with no matching wheel declares them unknown with a reason, at most 5 per document (3 of 71 on the real image: colorama, tzdata, tap).

generic._description: Components no package manager installed (the self-built OpenSSL FIPS provider): a purl and a CPE, because the CPE is the only identifier a scanner can match them by.

github._description: Released binaries identified by their GitHub repository (uv, uvx). No CPE exists for them; the purl is what a matcher reads.

golang._description: Go modules and the standard library recorded from binaries (the gosu binary in the tap-db image). Syft gives each a purl and a CPE; found by running the check on the real tap-db SBOM, where four such components were otherwise unruled.

operating_system._description: Exactly one operating-system component, with a name and a version. The grid reads it; its worth to Grype is not demonstrated (the ablation gave 50 matches with and without it).
